name: Temple of the Dawn
knownLimits: Materials are mixed: most stone/wood remains first-pass Blender-authored stylized colors, while stained glass now uses a generated painted lancet texture candidate.
The package now uses isolated pew, wall-window bay, and altar/incense asset candidates plus material-batched visible room meshes.
Runtime lighting is now driven by five authored LIGHTS_ markers, but Tavern still needs the same marker-driven lighting migration.
Stained-glass floor-light patches are subdued, but still procedural and should become a dedicated lighting/effects pass later.
The painted stained-glass texture is embedded in the GLB for this candidate; future asset-build work should move repeated textures toward optimized/compressed delivery.
The old procedural Temple builder remains in code as a temporary removal candidate.
